assessment.nobel_worthiness: KPZ supplied a remarkably simple universal mechanism for a broad class of far-from-equilibrium fluctuating interfaces, with unusually deep theoretical and experimental reach.
assessment.attribution: Kardar and Zhang established the defining theory; Takeuchi made exceptionally clean quantitative tests of its predicted universal fluctuations.
assessment.maturity: The universality class has been tested across many systems and its fluctuations are now understood with considerable precision.
uncertainties: Yi-Cheng Zhang's posthumous ineligibility complicates recognition of the original three-author formulation.
The boundary between a general statistical-physics framework and a prizeable discovery requires careful framing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Conformal field theory transformed the understanding of criticality by identifying exact, universal structures in two-dimensional many-body systems.
assessment.attribution: Polyakov and Cardy are central architects of the physical framework and its applications to critical phenomena.
assessment.maturity: Its consequences are deeply established analytically, numerically, and experimentally, and permeate modern statistical and quantum field theory.
uncertainties: Alexander B. Zamolodchikov's posthumous ineligibility prevents recognition of all principal contributors.
The proper boundary between this work and broader quantum-field-theory advances is debatable.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dynamical mean-field theory provided a tractable, conceptually powerful description of strong electronic correlations and changed the practice of condensed-matter theory.
assessment.attribution: These three figures made decisive foundational contributions to the formulation, solution, and broad establishment of DMFT.
assessment.maturity: The method is mature, widely benchmarked, and indispensable for interpreting correlated materials.
uncertainties: Credit for the several foundational formulations and later extensions is necessarily distributed.
Its status as a method rather than a discrete physical discovery may draw objection.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The jamming framework exposed a striking common structure behind rigidity, disorder, and mechanical response in granular, soft, and amorphous matter.
assessment.attribution: Liu and Nagel articulated the central unifying picture, while O'Hern supplied pivotal model studies that made its critical character precise.
assessment.maturity: A substantial theoretical and experimental literature now supports scaling and criticality near jamming.
uncertainties: The extent to which jamming is a single universality class across real materials remains contested.
The precise division of foundational credit is broad.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Geometric and topological phase concepts revealed that quantum mechanics retains observable global structure beyond local forces and energies.
assessment.attribution: Aharonov introduced a defining physical effect, while Berry identified the broadly applicable adiabatic geometric phase.
assessment.maturity: Both effects are thoroughly confirmed and have become organizing principles from condensed matter to precision quantum physics.
uncertainties: The two phenomena are distinct enough that combining them into one citation needs a compelling conceptual formulation.
Related topological concepts have already received Nobel recognition.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The quantum spin Hall and topological-insulator programme disclosed a new robust form of electronic order with major conceptual and experimental consequences.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele provided the decisive theoretical prediction, and Molenkamp led the landmark experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: The phenomena have been reproduced extensively and form a durable foundation for topological materials research.
uncertainties: The 2016 prize for topological phases makes the distinction from previously rewarded discoveries especially delicate.
Several experimental and theoretical contributors have strong claims to recognition.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Metamaterials made electromagnetic response an engineered design variable, enabling negative refraction and transformation-optics concepts once thought impossible.
assessment.attribution: Pendry supplied seminal theoretical proposals, and Smith provided influential experimental realization and demonstration.
assessment.maturity: The field is experimentally established and its methods have propagated widely through photonics and wave physics.
uncertainties: Early claims of negative refraction and perfect-lens performance prompted methodological controversy.
Applications have been less transformative than the original conceptual claims suggested.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Magnetically driven ferroelectricity revealed strong, controllable coupling between magnetic and electric order, opening a rich class of multiferroic physics.
assessment.attribution: Cheong, Tokura, and Ramesh each made major experimental and conceptual contributions to establishing multiferroics as a coherent field.
assessment.maturity: The underlying mechanisms are well established across several material families, though practical device impact remains limited.
uncertainties: Attribution is unusually diffuse across materials, mechanisms, and experimental groups.
The scale of technological consequence remains uncertain.
